name: Tab row
statusNote: PrimaryTabRow/SecondaryTabRow and their indicator shapes predate Expressive; no wavy/MaterialShapes indicator exists for tabs.
summary: A horizontal row of tabs that switches between sibling content panes. Use primary tabs (bold, centered indicator) at the top level under an app bar; use secondary tabs (thin underline) to further split content within a section that already has primary navigation.

inputs.name: selectedTabIndex
inputs.description: The index of the currently selected tab.

inputs.name: tabs
inputs.description: The row's tabs. Each tab has selected, onClick, and icon and/or label content.

inputs.name: style
inputs.description: Selects the token group and indicator behaviour.

inputs.name: scrollable
inputs.description: Fixed rows place tabs evenly across the full width; scrollable rows offset tabs from the start edge and lay them out at natural width, scrolling any overflow.

inputs.name: selectedContentColor
inputs.description: Per-tab colour override for its selected content.

inputs.name: unselectedContentColor
inputs.description: Per-tab colour override for its unselected content; defaults to the selected colour.

inputs.name: icon
inputs.description: Per-tab optional icon; icon+label tabs are taller than text-only tabs.

anatomy.name: Tab
anatomy.description: One selectable item: icon and/or label text.

anatomy.name: Active indicator
anatomy.description: A bar drawn under the selected tab, on top of the divider.

anatomy.name: Divider
anatomy.description: A hairline under the whole row (secondary tabs only by default).

variants.description: Top-level destinations, tabs evenly fill the row.
Top-level destinations that don't fit the row.
Sub-navigation within a section, evenly filled.
Sub-navigation that doesn't fit the row.

layout.text: Fixed tab rows place tabs evenly across the full width, each taking equal space.
Scrollable tab rows offset tabs from the start edge with an edge padding, defaulting to 52dp, and lay tabs out at their natural width, scrolling any overflow.
Scrollable tab rows enforce a minimum tab width of 90dp; fixed rows have no equivalent minimum — width is simply row-width divided by tab-count.
Text-only tabs use container-height; icon+label tabs use the taller icon-and-label-text-container-height token instead.
Text has 16dp horizontal padding inside the tab; an icon sits 8dp before the text and is vertically positioned by baseline distance, not a fixed gap.

Primary indicator width follows the content width (label/icon bounding box) rather than the full tab width, so it stays centered and shorter than the tab. Secondary indicator instead spans the tab's full width.
Both indicators enforce a minimum drawn width of 24dp to preserve a visible touch/visual target even for very narrow content.
The row divider sits at the bottom of the row, underneath (behind) the active indicator, spanning the full row width.

states.text: Single-select within the row; pressing a tab moves selection immediately — there is no intermediate "activating" state.
Interaction states (hover/focus/pressed, active/inactive) recolor the icon and label independently per token; the indicator itself has no hover/press variant, only active/inactive.

states.label: label-icon-crossfade
states.text: Label/icon colour cross-fades between active and inactive colour on selection change: fade-in uses a default-effects spring, fade-out uses a fast-effects spring.

states.label: indicator-motion
states.text: The active indicator's position (offset from row start) and, for the primary indicator, its width both animate independently using a default-spatial spring, each animating from its own current value on every selection change so a fast double-tap doesn't snap.

states.label: auto-scroll
states.text: Scrollable tab rows additionally auto-scroll the selected tab into view using the same default-spatial spring spec.

behaviour.text: A custom indicator composable and divider composable can be swapped in per row; the indicator receives an API to read animated tab positions.

Primary vs secondary is a styling and indicator-behaviour choice only — both are the same row implementation underneath; pick the token group and content-matching behaviour, not a different structural component.

keyboard: Arrow keys move focus between tabs within the group.
Enter or Space selects the focused tab.
semantics: Each tab behaves as a Tab role within a selectable group, so assistive tech announces the group and each item's selected state.

The 24dp minimum indicator width guarantees a visible affordance, but tab touch targets themselves should still meet the platform's general 48dp minimum, driven by container-height, not by the indicator.

notes.text: Don't restate a fixed row's per-tab width — it's row-width divided by tab count, not a token.
The divider is a plain horizontal rule, not a decoration owned by the indicator; a row with no divider is a legitimate custom composition.
